values.note: Town's 2026 table: fully serviced C$50, partially serviced (power/water) C$48, non-serviced tent or RV C$44, cabin C$100, plus GST, the non-refundable C$5.25 booking fee and a C$10 deposit. summary: Riverview kept (north-loop sites back onto the Lee Creek riprap bank); fees confirmed C$44 base, high now C$52 (2027 Campspot) with GST and C$5.25 booking fee; 64 sites (was 70), dump/showers/wifi from town page; season left as stored.
flags: Waterfront (asked to check riverview hard): riverview CONFIRMED, no downgrade. Imagery: the south loop (pin) sits ~80 m east of Lee Creek behind a riparian tree belt; the north loop's west row of back-in sites (around 49.1912,-113.3112) backs onto the creek's riprap bank, roughly 10-20 m from the channel with mostly open ground and scattered shrubs between and no campground road in between. For the reviewer: those few west-row north-loop sites might meet the ~50 m open-ground gate (a 'few clear waterfront sites' caveat case), but I did not upgrade per the never-upgrade rule.

Season: town page says 'OPERATING SEASON: Last week of April to the second week of October' and early-season April camping is by arrangement; stored 05-01/10-14 (Campspot calendar) left as is — close to but not exactly the town's wording.

Website https://www.cardston.ca/visitors/lee-creek-campground refuses curl (403) but loads in a browser; Campspot page is the booking link. Phone 403-388-4230 confirmed on the town page (town office 403-653-3366).
